versions.changelog:
- Initial release of statute-analysis-rafal-fryc-hardened skill for statutory interpretation guidance.
- Provides step-by-step advice on reading, interpreting, and applying statutes, regulations, and rules.
- Includes methods for verifying legal text status and understanding regulatory context.
- Summarizes core statutory interpretation concepts and tools, including operator words and canons of construction.
- Outlines approaches to categorize and extract different types of legal requirements.
